verdict.rationale: Parahelp's docs say simulations replay historical tickets or mock scenarios against task configurations, and that you can test the Customer Agent through the Internal Agent to see how it handles a scenario before customers do. This covers both halves of the story, historical tickets and simulated conversations, with production tests also checking tool connections. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration, and detail on simulation outputs and pass/fail reporting.

support.subject: As a support ops lead, I test the agent against historical tickets or simulated conversations before it faces real customers

citations.quote: Simulations replay your historical tickets - or mock scenarios - against the configurations in the task, and production tests verify your tool connections.
You test your Customer Agent by prompting the Internal Agent in a task, and see exactly how it handles a scenario before customers do.
